thread:
ravi: flagging a curious billing footprint from a streaming session that hit a mid-request truncation + region failover. seems like provisional tokens from a toolcall got counted alongside confirmed chunk tokens.
zoe: can you paste the shortest repro trace?
ravi: sure, condensed logs below. this one is from last night, customer=orbit-pay.
```
2026-03-25T02:12:10Z ingress: session=orb_100 open prefetch=pf_1001
2026-03-25T02:12:12Z backend-us1: emit chunk seq=1 tokens=+34
2026-03-25T02:12:13Z backend-us1: truncation applied policy=soft_evict seq=2
2026-03-25T02:12:14Z billing: provisional grant id=pg_999 session=orb_100 tokens=+180 reason=prefetch
2026-03-25T02:12:15Z network: client reconnect hint=session=orb_100
2026-03-25T02:12:15Z router: reroute -> backend-eu1 (affinity_miss)
2026-03-25T02:12:15Z backend-eu1: no cache -> toolcall fetch id=tc_455 tokens=+175 provenance=pf_1001
2026-03-25T02:12:16Z backend-us1: cleanup confirm ledger entries session=orb_100 tokens=+34
2026-03-25T02:12:17Z ledger-bot: finalization confirmed session=orb_100 tokens=+209
```
zoe: final is 209 but we expected either 34 (only emitted) or ~175 (if toolcall replaced work). looks like sum of both.
derek: ledger dedupe uses provisional_id, but provisional grants from backend-us1 and backend-eu1 had different provisional_ids because backend-eu1 created a fresh toolcall entry.
cassie: two angles: router route affinity vs ledger collapse. if we can transfer prefetch ownership on reconnect (backend-us1 -> backend-eu1) then backend-eu1 wouldn't fire toolcall. alternatively, ledger could collapse entries that share provenance (prefetch id) or share client_session_hint.
zoe: gotcha. what's risk of collapsing by provenance/prefetch id? if an unrelated request reuses same prefetch id hash we could undercount. but prefetch ids are unique per prefetch attempt, so low risk if we include a backend nonce.
derek: also need to handle out-of-order confirms across regions. backend-us1 confirm arrived after backend-eu1 provisional grant. ledger finalizer needs to pick the superset or apply last-writer-wins based on resume_seq.
cassie: proposal: - add resume_seq monotonic per session, incremented on each reconnect. tag provisional grants with (session, resume_seq, prefetch_id). ledger confirm uses (session, prefetch_id) but prefers the entry with highest resume_seq. - router: include resume_seq and prefetch_id in reconnect handshake so target backend can request ownership or decline toolcall if another provisional is in-flight.
zoe: short-term mitigations: - make toolcall token grants provisional and delay finalization by additional 5s when a reconnect hint is present. - console: surface per-session provisional spikes and link to reconnect events so support can quickly triage.
ledger-bot: alert: anomalous double-count detected customer=orbit-pay delta=+175 window=1m ticket=INC-2321
ravi: action items: Derek to draft ledger finalizer change (resume_seq precedence), Zoe to add console flag and support view, Cassie to prototype router reconnect handshake carrying prefetch_id/resume_seq. I'll own comms with support and the canary plan.
zoe: will add example query for support to map provisional grants -> traces.
derek: will include unit tests for cross-region confirm ordering and a migration plan for historical provisional entries.
cassie: will test ownership transfer flow; might be able to ship small router toggle behind feature flag.
ravi: thanks all. will update this thread when the ticket is live. :eyes:
